acceptanceCriteria: Either the driver runs sharded with active test slices (focused test over a slices fixture) or V1-1315's cutover retires it and this ticket is closed as superseded with the merge named.
While unresolved, the ci.yml comment beside CORVINT_PR_TOOL_SOURCE states that the pin must stay empty while test-slices.json is non-empty.
body: Observed 2026-10-13 while planning the AFP-V0-029 shadow campaign (owner request: run only the needed tests). tools/corvint-pr-tests/main.go execute() calls refuseSlices(universe, shards) for every sharded run (`test-level slices are active (AFP-V0-041); the package-level driver refuses sharded execution`, exit 2). .github/cishards/test-slices.json has been non-empty since revision 3b428343 (internal/tasks/store named slices), so setting CORVINT_PR_TOOL_SOURCE in .github/workflows/ci.yml today would take the driver branch of the Go tests step on every PR shard and fail all eight shards; the shadow `corvint test --dry-run` step shares that pin. Expected: a pinned driver either executes the slices it refuses (whole packages first, then each slice, as the full branch does) or the shadow can be activated independently of the driver. Workaround chosen by lane CI-ROWS: a separate CORVINT_TEST_SHADOW_SOURCE pin that builds only cmd/corvint, keeping the driver inert. Resolution candidates: (a) teach the driver AFP-V0-041 slices (needed only if the driver remains the CI executor), or (b) retire the driver at the V1-1315 cutover to `corvint test` and close this as superseded. Related: V1-1315, V1-0811, V1-0812, decision 0488.
title: ci: corvint-pr-tests refuses sharded execution while AFP-V0-041 test slices are active, so CORVINT_PR_TOOL_SOURCE cannot be set
